JMP safely managed water: methodology review of D1/D2 corrections (Option B) before the 2027 JMP release
features.description: SPI.D1.5.SAFE.MAN.WATER keeps the original method for 202611 (Option A, exact port of hyper_read). Two behaviours depart from the written definition: D1, areas without JMP data are credited as full coverage (the coverage rule max_value >= 99.5 | max_value <= 0.5 also fires on the -99 no-data sentinel); D2, national columns are read by the outdated `_n` suffix while JMP now uses `_t`. Correcting both (Option B) changes 52 countries in 2024 (up to 4 SPI points; 103 rank changes). Review with a full back-cast and public note before the 2027 JMP release. Evidence: docs/jmp-safely-managed-water-brief.md.
